violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: OBSERVED CAMBROS RUN THROUGH DISHWASHING MACHINE WHEN IT WAS NOT SANITIZING 50-200PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: CAMBROS SANITIZED IN QUAT SOLUTION OF ~300PPM QUATERNARY AMMONIA.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (2): TZATZIKI AT 48F AND HUMMUS AT 46F. ITEMS WERE PLACED IN COOLER 1.5HRS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS FOODS MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location in Holding Units
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device in the following mechanically refrigerated unit was not properly located in the warmest part of the unit: OBSERVED TWO COOLERS WITH THE THERMOMETERS LOCATED IN THE BACK OF THE UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanically refrigerated unit the sensor of a temperature measuring device shall be located to measure the air temperature of a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of the refrigerator. Store the thermometer near the door of the unit. CDI: THERMOMETERS MOVED TO THE FRONT OF THE UNITS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED (2) TWO-DOOR UNDER COUNTER COOLER AT 53F, HOLDING TCS FOODS 46-48F. OBSERVED CHEMICAL DISHWASHING MACHINE AT <50PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: COOLER EMPTIED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE DO NOT USE IT TO STORE TCS FOODS. IT MUST BE REPAIRED TO HOLD FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW BY 9/11/26. DO NOT USE DISHWASHER FOR SANITIZING UNTIL IT IS SERVICED TO SANITIZE AT 50-200PPM CHLORINE. IT MUST BE FIXED BY 9/11/26.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED AT HOT TABLE: LAMB MEATBALLS AT 130F (30MIN), SPICY CHICKEN AT 115-140F (30MIN) OBSERVED IN HOT WELLS: WHITE RICE AT 116F (30MIN), BROWN RICE AT 112F (30MIN)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: RICE DISPOSED OF AND MEAT WAS TAKEN TO OVEN TO REHEAT. TABLES DID NOT HAVE ENOUGH WATER TO CONDUCT HEAT/PIC RE- EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (3): HUMMUS AT 52F (1HR), TZATZIKI AT 46F (1HR), SPICY TOMATO SAUCE AT 56F (1HR) OBSERVED IN (5): COOKED EGGPLANT AT 50F (OVERNIGHT), HUMMUS 1 AT 54F (1HR), HUMMUS 2 AT 46F (OVERNIGHT), TZATZIKI AT 56F (1HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS ITEMS IMPROPERLY COLD HELD FOR 1HR WERE MOVED TO THE WALK-IN COOLER TO RAPID COOL, AND ITEMS IMPROPERLY COLD HELD OVERNIGHT WERE DISPOSED OF.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: EHS observed an employee wash and rinse a cutting board with following proper sanitization procedure in the quaternary ammonia based sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC stopped employee from returning cutting board and knife to work line and had employee sanitize cutting board and knife.
